module: Flowgraph node "Rally Mode Resync After Teleport" (category repeat_instant, tag rally). Clears the pacenotes' execution state and resynchronizes rally mode after a teleport or a reset, via gameplay_rally.getRallyManager():resyncAfterTeleport(). Copies flow to the output.
notes: The resync is called every frame the node runs, not only on a pulse; enable it only when needed.
The node does not check that gameplay_rally is loaded before calling getRallyManager.

work.desc: Calls rm:resyncAfterTeleport() (error logged if there is no rally manager) and copies the flow.
